description: This file implements a PermissionRequester class for managing runtime permission requests in an Android application. It handles checking permissions, showing rationale dialogs, requesting permissions, and directing users to app settings when necessary.

classes.name: PermissionRequester
classes.description: A class that manages requesting runtime permissions within an Android application, including showing rationale dialogs and navigating to app settings.

methods.name: requestIfMissing
methods.description: Requests permissions if they are not already granted, showing rationale if needed, and handling user responses.

methods.name: showRationaleDialog
methods.description: Displays a rationale dialog explaining why certain permissions are needed, awaiting user's response.

methods.name: showSettingsDialog
methods.description: Shows a dialog prompting the user to enable permissions manually in the app settings.

methods.name: buildRationaleMessage
methods.description: Creates a user-friendly message listing the permissions for which rationale is being shown.

methods.name: buildSettingsMessage
methods.description: Creates a message instructing the user to enable permissions in Settings.

methods.name: permissionLabel
methods.description: Maps Android permission strings to human-readable labels.
